spans.s:
m. (-विः)
The chin.
E.
चीव to take, कि affix, and the radical vowel shortened: see चिवु.

m. (-टः)
Flattened grain. A various reading of चिपिट, q. v.

m. (-वुः)
The chin: see the next.

n. (-कं)
The chin.
E.
चीव to take or cover, कु affix, and कन् added; also चिवु.

r. 10th cl. (चीवयति)
To shine.
2 To speak.
(-ऋ,) चीवृ r. 1st cl. (चीवति-ते)
1 To take.
2 To wear.

n. (-रं)
The tattered dress of a Bauddha mendicant, or of any mendicant.
E.
चि to collect, &c. and स्वरच् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-री)
A Bauddha or Jaina mendicant.
E.
चीवर a beggar's dress, and इनि aff.
